# KeyboardButtonPollType

**Qualified name:** `pyrogram.types.KeyboardButtonPollType`

## Constructor

```python
def __init__(type: Optional['enums.PollType'] = None): ...
```

## Documentation

The type of a poll that can be created and sent when the corresponding button is pressed.

### Parameters

- **`type`** ([`PollType`](../../enums/PollType.md), *optional*)
  If `QUIZ` is passed, the user will be allowed to create only polls in the
  quiz mode. If `REGULAR` is passed, only regular polls will be allowed.
  Otherwise, the user will be allowed to create a poll of any type.
